name: ST-away-passed-over
old: if (life.lived !== null) for (const a of boatAnimators(boat)) a.update(life.lived);
new: if (life.lived !== null && boat.GameObject.activeInHierarchy) for (const a of boatAnimators(boat)) a.update(life.lived);

name: ST-hidden-passed-over
old: if (lived !== null) for (const a of boatAnimators(s.boat)) a.update(lived);
new: if (lived !== null && !hide) for (const a of boatAnimators(s.boat)) a.update(lived);

name: ST-hidden-walked
old: if (lived !== null) for (const a of boatAnimators(s.boat)) a.update(lived);
new: if (lived !== null) for (const a of [...s.boat.GameObject.walk()].flatMap((n) => n.getComponents('Animator').map((c) => c.animator).filter(Boolean))) a.update(lived);

name: ST-naval-hud-door

name: ST-naval-hud-clock
old: if (!model || covered) { drawNavalHud(model, { dt: gamePaused() ? 0 : dt, covered }); return; }
